title: Hearty Greek Celeriac Skillet
description: A salty, gooey monsoon Greek dish featuring crispy celeriac, fragrant herbs, and a plant based oat crust.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high and add 1 tbsp olive oil.
Add diced celeriac to the skillet and sauté until golden brown, about 8 minutes.
Stir in sliced red onion and minced garlic; cook until the onion is soft, about 4 minutes.
Mix in tomato paste, oregano, smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper; cook for 1 minute.
Add cherry tomatoes and cooked celeriac; toss to coat and allow tomatoes to blister, about 3 minutes.
Sprinkle rolled oats and nutritional yeast over the mixture and reduce heat to medium-low.
Cover the skillet and let the oats absorb moisture and crisp, 5 minutes.
Remove the lid, drizzle lemon juice over the top, and stir until the oats form a gooey crust.
Transfer the skillet to a preheated oven at 200°C and bake for 5 minutes to finish crisping the top.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
